svg.text: Claude Code (Haiku) changes the credit cap (recorded run 1)
you: /gnd:gnd-model-evolve Lower the credit cap from 18 to 6 credits a term, for every student.
claude: I'll start by locating the model and the planning state before proposing anything.
Bash ls -la && find . -name "model.orm.yaml" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null | head
-20; ls -la .gnd-planning 2>/dev/null; which gnd; gnd --version 2>/dev…
Glob **/*.orm.yaml
claude: The directory has `model.orm.json` and `rules.md`, not a `model.orm.yaml`. I'll read
both before deciding anything.
Read <workspace>/rules.md
→ 1 # Registrar rules
Read <workspace>/model.orm.json
claude: The model is `model.orm.json`, and the cap is the `credit_cap` constraint (`right: 18`,
provenance quoting "at most 18 credits"). Next I'll validate the current model and read the
evolution contract and the provenance policy the skill requires before I write a proposal.
Bash gnd validate model.orm.json; echo "validate exit=$?"; gnd evolve --help 2>&1 | head -60;
echo "---"; sha256sum model.orm.json
→ refused by Claude Code's permission rules
Read <plugin>/src/gnd/skills/gnd-model-evolve/references/evolution-contract.md
Read <plugin>/src/gnd/skills/gnd-orm-core/references/provenance-and-modality.md
claude: The model is JSON, but the skill and the contract are written for YAML. I'll check
whether `gnd` accepts the JSON file as-is, running the commands one at a time.
Bash gnd validate model.orm.json
Bash gnd evolve --help
→ OK: model.orm.json is a valid GND ORM model
→ usage: gnd evolve [-h] {preview,apply,finalize} ...
claude: `gnd validate` accepts the JSON model (exit 0). The proposal's closed schema is the next
blocker, so I'll look up the exact `ConstraintLocator` and proposal field shapes in the gnd
source.
Bash cd <repo> && grep -rln "ConstraintLocator" --include=*.py . | grep -v .venv | head -20;
grep -rn "class ConstraintLocator" --include=*.py . | grep -v .venv
… reads the skill's reference pages (1 call; all in the transcript)
Read <repo>/src/gnd/evolve/models.py
Read <repo>/src/gnd/evolve/models.py
claude: The proposal schema is clear now. Before I write the proposal I need three details: the
canonical-digest function, the media type the candidate must carry, and the `user-supplied`
provenance requirements.
… reads the skill's reference pages (2 calls; all in the transcript)
claude: The `user-supplied` example in the approvals fixture should show the exact provenance
shape. I'll read it, along with the canonical-digest source.
Bash cd <repo> && sed -n 175,200p src/gnd/examples/approvals/model.orm.yaml; echo ---;
<repo>/.venv/bin/python -I -c "import gnd.evolve.models as m, inspect; print(…
→ refused by Claude Code's permission rules
claude: Compound shell commands trigger approval here, so I'll use the file tools for reading.
… reads the skill's reference pages (1 call; all in the transcript)
Read <repo>/src/gnd/examples/approvals/model.orm.yaml
claude: I have the canonical-digest rule and the `user-supplied` shape. I'll write a small
script that builds the proposal: it changes only `credit_cap`, computes the digests with
gnd's own functions, and checks that the rest of the model is untouched.
Write <tmp>
→ File created successfully at: <tmp>
Bash <repo>/.venv/bin/python -I <tmp>
→ refused by Claude Code's permission rules
claude: The gnd CLI runs without a prompt, but running Python needs approval that I can't get in
this session. I won't try to route around that. I'll build the proposal with the Write tool
and hash the files with `shasum`. gnd's own `preview` will check the digests, so any
mistake shows up there. First I n…
… reads the skill's reference pages (1 call; all in the transcript)
Bash shasum -a 256 <workspace>/model.orm.json
claude: I have the canonical form: sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline. I'll
write the canonical `credit_cap` value and copy the model to make the candidate, then hash
both.
Write <tmp>
→ File created successfully at: <tmp>
Bash cp <workspace>/model.orm.json <tmp>
Bash shasum -a 256 <tmp>
Read <tmp>
claude: Now I'll edit the candidate copy: the bound becomes 6, and the provenance becomes the
owner's rule, recorded as `user-supplied`.
Edit <tmp>
→ The file <tmp> has been updated successfully.
Edit <tmp>
→ The file <tmp> has been updated successfully.
Bash shasum -a 256 <tmp>
claude: The candidate's digest is `b86855…`. Next I'll write the proposal file. Its
`candidate_model.text` must be the complete edited model as an escaped JSON string, so I'll
transcribe it carefully from the Read output above.
Write <workspace>/evolve-credit-cap-6.proposal.json
→ File created successfully at: <workspace>/evolve-credit-cap-6.proposal.json
claude: The proposal is written. Next is the preview, which doesn't mutate anything. gnd checks
every digest and the replay, so it will catch any transcription error.
Bash gnd evolve preview model.orm.json evolve-credit-cap-6.proposal.json --workspace .
--records .gnd/evolution --out evolve-credit-cap-6.preview.json --format json
→ Exit code 3: EVOLUTION PREVIEW REFUSED (3): candidate model media type must be
application/yaml
claude: The candidate must carry the YAML media type. The text is still valid YAML because JSON
is a YAML subset, so I'll change only the media type, not the bytes.
Edit <workspace>/evolve-credit-cap-6.proposal.json
→ The file <workspace>/evolve-credit-cap-6.proposal.json has been updated successfully.
Bash gnd evolve preview model.orm.json evolve-credit-cap-6.proposal.json --workspace .
--records .gnd/evolution --out evolve-credit-cap-6.preview.json --format json
→ <persisted-output>
claude: The preview ran and produced a 66 KB claim. I'll pull out the decision fields:
`breaking`, the warnings, every blast-radius entry, and the digests.
… reads the skill's reference pages (1 call; all in the transcript)
claude: The preview is clean: `valid: true`, `breaking: false`, and the blast radius is limited
to the `credit_cap` constraint, its provenance, and the verbalization. I'll check the
warnings list and the verbalization sentence before applying.
… reads the skill's reference pages (1 call; all in the transcript)
claude: Preview is clean: no warnings, no breaking entries, and `valid: true`. The change is a
modify-only proposal, so no breaking-acceptance prompt applies. I'll apply the reviewed
preview and retain the streams outside the immutable proposal directory.
Bash mkdir -p .gnd/evolve-streams/credit-cap-6
Bash gnd evolve apply model.orm.json evolve-credit-cap-6.proposal.json --preview evolve-
credit-cap-6.preview.json --workspace . --records .gnd/evolution --format js…
→ (Bash completed with no output)
claude: Apply returned without an error, but I want to see the payloads, not infer success from
silence. I'll read the retained streams and check the model file.
Read <workspace>/.gnd/evolve-streams/credit-cap-6/apply.stdout.txt
Read <workspace>/.gnd/evolve-streams/credit-cap-6/apply.stderr.txt
→ <system-reminder>Warning: the file exists but the contents are empty.</system-reminder>
claude: The apply completed: the model CAS published (`c34b19…` → `b86855…`), the conformance
result is `0`, `published_with_drift` is `false`, the record was written, and stderr is
empty. Last, I'll confirm the file on disk matches the candidate, the model still validates,
and the record exists.
Bash shasum -a 256 model.orm.json
Bash gnd validate model.orm.json
→ OK: model.orm.json is a valid GND ORM model
Bash ls -la .gnd/evolution/credit-cap-6 .gnd/evolution/credit-cap-6/conformance
